name: Ryoden Corporation
summary: Ryoden Corporation sells factory automation (FA) systems, cooling and heating systems, information and communication technologies (ICT), building systems, smart agriculture, healthcare, system integration, and electronics businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through FA Systems Business, Refrigeration and Cooling Building Systems Business, X-Tech Business, and Electronics Business segments. The FA Systems Business segment offers servo systems, inverters, and NC devices. The Refrigeration and cooling building systems business segment provides packaged air conditioners, chilling units, freezers, and elevators.
